proposition.claim:
The tensor-cube map has cubic nullspace image, outside its second osculating plane; dim(LP/Z)=3 but stated span dimension<=2.

Dimension, fixed complementary-vector parallelism, Gram/phase, Taylor, strict-row and sign formulas require correction.

Zariski density and chain surjectivity alone do not justify avoiding bad flags with fixed endpoint; finite incidence gives direct replacement.

Failure of properness of first factor does not by stated inference imply properness of second factor on all boundary sequences; self-reference requires justification. Published rigidity application needs exact hypothesis match.

Parallel ambient blocks do not imply tangent of restricted saturated family is parallel.
